description: Cross-mesh AT2 energy evaluation and physical decomposition of the +2.03% energy offset

scientific_assessment.source_state_sensitivity: EXTREMELY_LOW (0.0000% total energy difference between P115 and P118)
scientific_assessment.critique_of_100pct_discretization_claim: The phrase '100% intrinsic spatial discretization' is an empirical observation within the tested discrete model family, not a formal mathematical proof of the continuum limit. The total energy shift (+2.026%) is partitioned into: (1) pure numerical quadrature integration on the fixed transferred field (-0.12% fracture energy change), and (2) natural phase-field crack-tip sharpening (+9.46% fracture energy increase) as the fine mesh (h/l0 = 0.081) resolves peak strain energy concentration that was spatially diffused on the coarse donor (h/l0 = 0.333). Stored energy between different nonmatching discretizations is not a strictly conserved invariant in regularized damage mechanics.
